current_activity: Operation Vénérable: leads the ground offensive of the Atlantic detachment against the Royan pocket
notes: Event date: 15 April 1945 (French Wikipedia); the operation ends on 17 April. Event definition: After air, naval and artillery bombardment from 15 April, the Gironde marching division of General d'Anselme leads the ground offensive against the Royan pocket with the Oléron brigade and armor of the 2nd Armored Division; the operation ends on 17 April with the German surrender. Event support: one source family (Wikipedia). Wikipedia, Poche de Royan et de la pointe de Grave (French Wikipedia), section Les opérations militaires et les redditions: "Elle démarre le 15 avril 1945 par un nouveau bombardement"; "L'offensive terrestre est menée par une division de marche « Gironde » (23 700 hommes) confiée au général André d'Anselme (future 23e division d'infanterie)"; "s'achève le 17 avril 1945". Location: Royan, Charente-Maritime with a precision of 5 km. Location approximate: the point is the town of Royan; the pocket extends around it. Location support: French Wikipedia names Royan as the objective; the point is the town; one source family; precision 5 km for the pocket around the town. Commander: General André d'Anselme commands the marching division (French Wikipedia).
